message: FPGA architecture proposal was rejected before VHDL generation. Architecture contract failed deterministic validation with 21 issue(s).

issues.message: schemaVersion must be "1.0" or "2.0". New contracts must use "2.0".
designName must be a non-empty basic identifier.
designClass must remain "uart_spi_protocol_bridge" for this request.
systemIntent must be precise and must not contain placeholders.

Exactly one top component is required and its name must equal topEntity.
Exactly one testbench component is required and its name must equal topTestbench.
